For my own edification, I've been making a list of variant cards and their status as to existence in the main Sentinels universe or another Sentinels universe. I thought I'd share.

The terms I'm using: Sentinels-Prime (the main universe), Sentinels-Iron (the Iron Legacy universe), Sentinels-XTREME! (the universe of the XTREME Sentinels), Sentinels-Wasteland (the universe represented by the Wasteland), Sentinels-Two (the universe where Baron Blade kills Paul Parsons and Pauline becomes Legacy), Kingkiller (the universe of Kvothe the Six String), Sentinels-Mirror (the universe with a heroic Baron Blade/Luminary and an evil Legacy), Sentinels-Revo (universe where Benchmark is a real hero and Revo-Corp are good guys), and Sentinels-Puzzler (the universe America's Cleverest Legacy comes from).

Not listed, because no promo comes from them yet, are Sentinels-Cocoon (the universe Visionary comes from), Sentinels-Soviet (the universe ColdWar comes from), or the universes represented on the cover of Darkwatch #18.

SENTINELS-PRIME

The main universe (from our viewpoint). The home of the Freedom Five, Dark Watch, Prime Wardens, Southwest Sentinels, and many others. The primary setting of Sentinels of the Multiverse.

Associated variants:

  • Termi-Nation Absolute Zero

  • Dark Watch Mister Fixer
  • Prime Warden Argent Adept
  • Dark Watch Nightmist
  • Dark Visionary
  • Best of Times Chrono-Ranger (also Sentinels-Wasteland)
  • Omnitrox-U
  • Rogue Agent KNYFE
  • Hunted Naturalist
  • Fugue State Parse
  • Adamant Sentinels
  • Void Guard Sentinels

  • Scholar of the Infinite (?)
  • Cosmic Omnitron
  • Agent of Gloom Spite
  • Skinwalker Gloomweaver
  • Unstable Kismet (?)
  • Tormented Ally Infinitor

SENTINELS-TWO

A universe where Baron Blade kills Legacy (aka Paul Parsons) and Pauline Parsons takes up his mantle much earlier than expected.

Associated variants:

  • Young Legacy

SENTINELS-IRON

A universe where Baron Blade kills Pauline Parsons and her father becomes a global dictator after killing the villain.

Associated variants:

  • Freedom Six Absolute Zero
  • Freedom Six Bunker
  • Freedom Six Tachyon
  • Freedom Six Tempest
  • Freedom Six Unity
  • Freedom Six Wraith

SENTINELS-XTREME!

A universe where a more "extreme" variant of the Prime Wardens exists.

Associated variants:

  • XTREME Fanatic
  • XTREME Haka
  • XTREME Tempest
  • XTREME Argent Adept
  • XTREME Captain Cosmic

SENTINELS-WASTELAND

A universe where, in the future, earth has become a world overrun by monsters.

Associated variants:

  • Eternal Haka
  • Best of Times Chrono-Ranger (also Sentinels-Prime)

SENTINELS-PUZZLER

A universe where Paul Parsons' chief abilities seem to be puzzle solving and not physical strength.

Associated variants:

  • America's Cleverest Legacy

SENTINELS-MIRROR

A universe where Baron Blade (and perhaps other villains?) are heroes while Legacy (and perhaps other heroes?) are villains.

Associated variants:

  • Ivana Ramonat Luminary

SENTINELS-REVO

A universe where RevoCorp is a group of angel investors and most heroes have fallen - except for Benchmark.

Associated variants:

  • Supply and Demand Benchmark

KINGKILLER

Based on the Kingkiller Chronicles by Patrick Rothfuss. It is unknown if this is the actual universe created by Mr. Rothfuss or an alternate version that mixes super heroics with high fantasy.

Associated variants:
  • Kvothe the Six String: Kingkiller.

SENTINELS-COCOON

A universe where the US Government's Project Cocoon led to the creation of Visionary.

Associated variants: NONE

SENTINELS-SOVIET

A universe that is home to ColdWar and possibly other Soviet versions of familiar heroes.

Associated variants: NONE

UNKNOWN

Guise variants, given their whimsical and metatextual nature, may exist in universes other than Sentinels-Prime.

Associated variants

  • Santa Guise: Who the heck knows?
  • Completionist Guise: Who the heck knows?
  • Action Hero Stuntman: Possibly from Sentinels-Mirror.

posts.name: Jgraygaming2
posts.cooked:
@djwewassson: Gotcha. That puts Action Hero Stuntman as from another universe. Possibly Sentinels-Mirror. We don't have enough clues yet to place him specifically.

With Best of Times Chrono Ranger, we have no reason to believe him to be a different man than the original Chrono Ranger, so though his story starts outside time he is still from Sentienels-Prime by way of Sentinels-Wasteland.

@chaosmancer: That gets complicated. As I understand it, the Mars mission against Baron Blade was supposed to result in two different timelines: one where Paul Parsons dies and his daughter becomes Legacy and one where Pauline dies and her father becomes Iron Legacy. Thanks to the events of Shattered Timelines, neither happened. That, in my opinion, puts America's Newest Legacy in an alternative universe. I've named it Sentinels-Two but acknowledge Sentinels-Two and Sentinels-Cocoon could be the same dimension. Visionary has said Paul Parsons is nothing like her Legacy, after all. 

As for Guise, I was mostly kidding. After all, we all know Guise is really the other dimensional duplicate of Pinkie Pie from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic.

@Ironic: Yes. Visionary would come from Sentinels-Cocoon (which may also be Sentinels-Two, see above) but I was only listing variants. Dark Visionary is, as far as I understand, the same Visionary possessed by an alien entity of some sort. So, she'd also be Earth-Cocoon.

@Belle Sorciere: I believe Dark Visionary to be the original Visionary, just possessed by an entity from outside time and space (aka Jean Grey) since she is freed of that being during the OblivAEON storyline... And that being possibly becomes the "aid aeon".

posts.cooked:
Dark Visionary's text from the wiki:

Less than a year after using her considerable psychic abilities to wrench herself backwards through time, Vanessa Long could feel the impact of her actions. She constantly ached, fought against daily migraines, and her mind was scattered - focusing on this time and reality grew more difficult with each passing day. Worst of all, the dark version of herself which had "hitched a ride" on her jaunt through time fed off her pain.
Anyway, I think the timeline between Visionary's disappearance and reappearance is a bit short to really fit for the "scion's aid" character.
